items.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming

items.lede: Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen.
